name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg's Walking Bombs spawn 20 yards away, not under him (#12029)
contract: Issue #12029: Thermaplugg's kit Walking Bombs (9780710) appeared under the boss. The kit summoned each one at
SMART_TARGET_RANDOM_POINT range 20, whose radius is uniform from 0 to 20 yards. The kit's in-game check places
them about 20 yards from him, so each Jackhammer (2102788, first cast 9.1-11.1 s into combat) now summons
three bombs on a 20-yard ring around him. The fight runs at his own spawn point in Gnomeregan, so the ring
lands on his room's floor. The tank re-enters grouped with the observer, so both share his instance. Self Root
Forever 42716 holds him there: it has no mechanic, so his root immunity (-229) does not block it. He is
defensive and a tank bot holds him, so only the tank is on his threat list and Jackhammer's and Knock Away's
knockbacks cannot move the observer, who stands 3 yards from him and never attacks. The nearest ring bomb is
then 17-23 yards from the observer. With the old uniform radius, the nearest of three bombs lands within 15
yards of the observer in about 98% of casts.

steps.label: The tank leaves its own Gnomeregan instance
The tank joins the observer's group
The tank enters the observer's Gnomeregan instance
CONTROL: the fight is in Gnomeregan
CONTROL: the tank shares Thermaplugg's instance
CONTROL: no Walking Bomb before the fight
CONTROL: Jackhammer summons three Walking Bombs
No Walking Bomb spawns at Thermaplugg's feet
CONTROL: the observer still stands 3 yards from Thermaplugg
